description: Folder and file metadata encryption test vectors for cross-platform interop
notes: Metadata is AES-256-GCM sealed (random IV prepended). Ciphertexts are non-deterministic due to random IV, so tests should encrypt->decrypt roundtrip using the provided folderKey. The plaintext JSON structures are the canonical v2 format both platforms must produce and consume.

folderMetadata.description: v2 folder metadata with FilePointer children (per-file IPNS)

fileMetadata.description: v1 per-file metadata (stored at individual IPNS records)

fieldRules.encryptionMode: Optional, defaults to 'GCM' if absent. Values: 'GCM' or 'CTR'
fieldRules.cid: IPFS CID of encrypted file content
fieldRules.fileIv: File encryption IV (hex) — 12 bytes for GCM, 16 bytes for CTR
fieldRules.versions: Optional array of VersionEntry objects (file versioning)
